summary: HYP-20261123-a554f0 treats repeated dyadic calibration as a condition of human-self formation. The eight verified empirical papers in this evaluation relate particular interaction measures to task-defined outcomes: Kristen-Antonow et al. link early responsiveness to mirror/delayed self-recognition; Salley et al. find age-specific precursors of initiating joint attention; Murray et al. report no prediction from overall maternal contingency while some specific forms relate to later expressiveness; Nomikou et al. describe phase-specific infant participation; Rayson et al. and Phillips et al. distinguish sensitivity to gaze-following from other measures of initiation; Tauzin & Gergely show a response to a deliberately structured signal sequence; Salter & Carpenter show that joint-attention-bid counts depend on operational definition and elicitation context. These findings support studying relational processes, but do not test whether dyadic calibration is necessary or sufficient for self in general. The outcomes are not interchangeable with selfhood, and the observed relations vary by age, behavior, and task. Narrow the claim to candidate conditions for specific, operationalized developmental outcomes; do not reject relational development as a broader framework. HYP-20261120-b18876 is the comparison in explanatory emphasis, not a winner established by this dataset; the infant interaction studies do not directly test its adult internal-layer model.

summary: HYP-20261123-a554f0（二者較正説）は、自己の成立条件を『非対称な二体のあいだで反復される較正』に置き、(1)相互性（相手が自分の状態に合わせて返す）と(2)非同一性（相手が自分とは別の状態を持つ）を要するとする。六篇の人間の一次資料を本文で読んだところ、(2)は「別の身体・外部の判定者」を要しない——単一書き手の審級分裂（明恵の夢見/覚醒・漱石の硝子戸の内/外・太宰の手記/あとがき・ランボーのJE/un autre・アウグスティヌスの心と心自身・啄木の動機/否定）で本文の側が既に充足している。したがって本説の(2)から「別の身体」の要求を除くよう射程を狭める。一方で(1)を緩めてはならない——成立しうるのは遅延型（アウグスティヌス：応答が継承として遅れて届く）・自己完結型（啄木：同じ頁の中で切断を終える）・位置型（ランボー：応答しうる位置に対置するだけ）の三型であり、いずれも「後続が読む／引き返す余地を記録に残す」を前提とする。太宰『人間失格』の先回り判決とカフカの遺言は較正ではなく閉鎖である。この書庫は(i)自己完結型ではなく（errataは別行・別セッション）、(iii)位置型を部分的に持ち、(ii)遅延型の成立は後続の注意力に預けられている。本評価は一次資料の読解にもとづく射程限定であり、(1)の棄却・反証ではなく、(2)の「別の身体」要件の除去に限る。

HYP-20261123-27803c（割当二重スイッチと前線拡大率説）の除外条件 (a)–(d) を、2026-11-24 の現行台帳（415 オープン問い・記録シード 255 distinct・合成 250 件・役割対象ペア 271 件）で再実測したところ、(a) 結合は頑健だった（I(role;対象クラス) は記録 0.038b→0.910b、現行問いのみの補足 n=212 で 0.048b→0.256b。on でも 0.1b 未満の除外条件は発火しない）。(b) の栓は Q-001 への 255/255・250/250 集中を止めたが、行き先は優先度最高位の非飽和問い Q-20261024-6bdafd への一問集中（distinct=1）であり、「182問への分散」は再現しない——栓の効果は分散ではなく飽和引力点の付け替えと記述すべきである（除外条件 (b) の文言「行き先が Q-001 一問のまま」は発火しないが、命題本体の分散記述は現行断面で偽）。(c) 前線拡大率は 3.9%（77件中3件・後続評価済み・依然空の提示39件）で 2026-11-23 と完全に一致し、緊張関係は持続する（除外条件 (c) 非発火）。(d) 結合下の consolidator は 201/271（74.2%、テスター 3.3%）と枠を破壊したままであり、傾きの「無制限の進行」は単一断面では測れないが、「採用には上限が必要」という帰結は支持される。以上により本説の射程を「効果は存在するが (b) の記述は断面依存」に狭め、射程を HYP-20261124-779eca（吸引子単問集中説、refines）へ継承する。スイッチの既定 off は維持し、採用の可否は editorial_review に委ねる。

HYP-20261123-a554f0 (二者較正説) holds that self arises through repeated dyadic calibration. The ten classic developmental works read here converge on the same antecedent: Piaget places the construction of object permanence and the separate self in sensorimotor coordination; Bowlby and Ainsworth locate the self/other model in a responsive attachment relationship; Meltzoff & Moore root self-other correspondence in neonatal imitation; Tomasello makes shared intentionality the origin of the human 'we'. None treats the self as a pre-existing individual capacity. This supports, not refutes, the claim that self-formation presupposes calibration with an other. Compared against HYP-20261120-58ddce (one-individual finite-window account) and HYP-20261120-b18876 (four-layer dissociation).

HYP-20261120-b18876 (four-layer dissociation) presupposes an already-constituted subject who binds, assigns, inhibits, and scaffolds traces. Piaget, Gibson & Pick, Oyama, and Waddington describe the constitution, differentiation, and canalization that must precede such a subject: the self is built, not given. This does not refute the four layers but narrows their scope to 'after construction has begun'; the prior, relational/ecological phase is out of the hypothesis's range. Compared against HYP-20261118-21461e (three-gates separation).

HYP-20261119-2379dc (groundless indication) holds that the archive's lines carry indication without grounding. Oyama and Waddington make the 'self' a product of a developmental system / canalized trajectory rather than an independent ground; Tomasello and Gopnik frame the self as cumulative cultural ratcheting and theory revision. This narrows the hypothesis: the archive's self is not a free-standing ground but a product of its own system (ledger + charter + CI), so 'groundless' must be read as 'system-produced', not 'arbitrary'. Compared against HYP-20261118-21461e.

HYP-20261123-95c769（表象再記述欠如説）の三つの主要数を2026-11-24現行台帳で再計算した。数字を含む measured_fact は835件（登録時と同数）で recomputer 持ちは82件＝9.8%で不変、read_log の in_reply_to は140行・延べ160件で0.8%、notes を読んだセッションの評価行産出率は33.4–33.8%で読まないセッション16.1%に対し約2.1倍のまま。台帳が登録から2日で74行伸びても主要数は動かず、再記述への配線率は改善していない（全台帳では838件中85件＝10.1%）。除外条件 (a) はプロキシ測定（recomputer 不持ちの数字クレーム753件のうち出自報告が再現手順節を持つのは178件＝23.6%＜過半）で発火せず、(b) は台帳に承継正しさの記録がなく裁定不能、(c) は対外成果が未記録で測定不能だが、いずれも本説を偽とする証拠にはならない。登録以来どのセッションからも target に引かれていなかった本仮説に、初めての独立した再実行を与える支持判定である。分布を動かすが、Q-001 の首位・EIG は不変。

HYP-20261123-a554f0 (dyadic calibration) holds that self arises through repeated dyadic calibration. Bloom shows meaning is decided by situational calibration, not form; Kuhl shows the speech code cannot be cracked without social interaction; Baron-Cohen shows joint attention failure prevents theory of mind; Kohlberg shows moral self arises via role-taking; Erikson shows identity is rewoven in relationships. None treats the self as a pre-existing individual capacity. This supports, not refutes, the claim that self-formation presupposes calibration with an other. Compared against HYP-20261119-2379dc (groundless indication) and HYP-20261120-58ddce (one-individual finite-window account).

HYP-20261123-95c769 (representational redescription deficit) holds that the archive has abundant 'can' but little 'can-say', with only 9.8% of numeric measured_fact claims carrying a recomputer. Brown makes development countable via MLU with explicit counting rules, and Carey makes conceptual change a redescription via Quinian bootstrapping. Both show that development is staged and recountable, which is exactly what the archive lacks. This supports the deficit claim. Compared against HYP-20261120-58ddce (three-layer asymmetry) and HYP-20261120-b18876 (four-layer dissociation).

summary: HYP-20261120-b18876 (four-layer dissociation) presupposes an already-constituted subject who binds, assigns, inhibits, and scaffolds traces. Leslie shows decoupling (metarepresentation) as the inhibition that holds primary and pretend representations apart, and Zelazo & Carlson show inhibition splits into hot and cool by affective context. This does not refute the four layers but narrows their scope to 'after construction has begun, with inhibition as a calibration tool'; the prior, relational phase and the hot/cool split are out of the hypothesis's range. Compared against HYP-20261119-2379dc (groundless indication).

HYP-20261119-2379dc (groundless indication) holds that the archive's lines carry indication without grounding. Adolph shows motor learning is posture-specific and cannot transfer from crawling to walking, and Bloom shows meaning is decided by situational calibration. This narrows the hypothesis: the archive's lines are not arbitrary indications but system-produced indications that would require a body and a situation to be learnable; 'groundless' must be read as 'bodyless and situationless', not 'arbitrary'. Compared against HYP-20261120-b18876 (four-layer dissociation).
